scope: Open issues excluding pull requests; issue bodies and available comments reviewed.

issues.title: `JSError.ThrowTypeError` / `ThrowRangeError` / `ThrowSyntaxError` throw a plain `Error`
issues.assessment: String helper calls ThrowError rather than ThrowTypeError; C addon gets a real TypeError from the same native library.

issues.title: JSError.ThrowError(Exception) aborts the process when a Worker terminates during a .NET call
issues.assessment: Report concerns JSError during CLR-in-Worker teardown; keeping the unmodified NodeApi package. Pure JS worker termination passes, which does not prove this case.

issues.title: dependency resolution on a non-JS thread fails with 0x80131509 instead of falling back
issues.assessment: Assembly resolution emits JS notifications on a non-JS thread; no native source change indicated.

issues.title: IDisposable: typings say `dispose()`, dynamic binding exposes `Dispose()`
issues.assessment: Dispose name mismatch is in typings versus TypeExporter.

issues.title: SIGSEGV (exit 139) on Node worker_threads teardown after require('node-api-dotnet/net10.0') - pthread TLS destructor use-after-free
issues.assessment: TLS destructor report loads CLR from a Node Worker. Our existing-CLR embedding direction does not exercise that teardown.

issues.title: C# AOT compilation not setting "dotnet" to undefined
issues.assessment: Generated AOT loader replacement uses the wrong module string.

issues.title: System.Management throws PlatformNotSupportedException under hosted CLR on Windows — breaks Hardware.Info, DeviceId.Windows.Wmi,   etc.
issues.assessment: System.Management and assembly load context; Windows-only reproduction unavailable.
